logger.message: #[write({timestamp: now() as String, synthetic: true, event: "order.received", api: p("api.name"), release: p("release.version"), correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, storeId: vars.order.storeId, sku: vars.order.sku, quantity: vars.order.quantity}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

#[write({timestamp: now() as String, synthetic: true, event: "order.completed", api: p("api.name"), release: p("release.version"), correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, orderId: payload.orderId, storeId: payload.storeId}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

set-variable.value: #[if (error.errorType.identifier == "OUT_OF_STOCK") 409 else if (error.errorType.identifier == "BAD_REQUEST") 400 else if (error.errorType.identifier == "INVALID_STOCK_CONTRACT") 502 else (error.errorMessage.attributes.statusCode default 500)]

logger.message: #[write({timestamp: now() as String, synthetic: true, event: "request.failed", api: p("api.name"), release: p("release.version"), correlationId: vars.traceId default correlationId, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier), detail: error.description, status: vars.status}, "application/json", {indent: false})]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- {error: if (vars.status == 409) "OUT_OF_STOCK" else if (vars.status == 400) "BAD_REQUEST" else "DEPENDENCY_FAILURE", correlationId: vars.traceId}

when.expression: #[not ((vars.order.sku default null) is String and (vars.order.storeId default null) is String and (vars.order.quantity default null) is Number)]

raise-error.description: sku, storeId and numeric quantity are required
quantity must be a positive integer
Inventory contract violation: availableQuantity must be Number
